notice: TEMPLATE ONLY. Every value below is a placeholder. This file must never be imported into production. Copy it, replace every placeholder with approved real data, and validate with `npx tsx scripts/market/validate-pilot-import.ts <file>` before any onboarding step.

store.supportOwner: <name and contact of the person who answers buyers>
store.incidentOwner: <name and contact of the person who handles incidents>

rules.productCount: 10-30 products; fewer than 10 is not a pilot, more than 30 is not reviewable by one person
rules.priceMinor: integer UZS only. No decimals, no strings, no thousands separators, no ranges. 0 is allowed only for a genuinely free item; the ceiling is 1000000000000
rules.currency: UZS is the only accepted value
rules.onHand: non-negative integer opening balance; every product needs one before it can be confirmed
rules.sku: optional; uppercase A-Z 0-9 . _ / -, up to 64 characters, must start alphanumeric, unique within the store
rules.name: 2-120 characters, must not be a bare URL
rules.searchTerms: up to 12 terms, each up to 60 characters. Add Uzbek Latin synonyms here so RU and UZ buyers find the same product
rules.specifications: up to 12 entries, label up to 40 and value up to 100 characters. Only verified facts: an absent specification is rendered as unknown, never invented
rules.mediaRefs: up to 5 opaque references matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*$. These are Telegram photo file_id values, NOT http URLs. A URL contains / and is rejected. Leave the array empty when there is no approved photo
rules.categoryKey: must match one of the declared categories
